title: ACC cosignal signed-manifest (CT-published; SCP-consumed via federation-primitive Renovate cascade)
description: Schema for the CT-published Ed25519-signed manifest per D-036 Element 3. Schema version d-036-mcp-manifest-v1. SCP-R-006 Inv-C consumes this read-only via `input.signed_manifest` (workflow-materialised). The manifest carries per-target-repo MCP server source SHA256 digests; an SHA mismatch on the on-disk `<repo>/.acc/mcp_server.{py,ts}` fires Inv-C as unconditional deny (per RULE-003 §3.2 SB-MAJ-003 — tamper detection is binary).

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. v1 is the initial v1.4.0-ship version. Version evolution discipline per D-036 Element 3 §Schema-version evolution (JWKS-style multi-version coexistence; version-allowlist enforced in workflow consumer; additive PATCH/MINOR, MAJOR for breaking).

signed_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp at which the manifest was signed by CT. Consumer-side staleness check: warn if signed_at > 7 days ago; deny if > 30 days (TBD — separate RFC).

key_id.description: Public-key identifier (ssh-ed25519 thumbprint or equivalent). Consumer verifies the signature against the key referenced by this id from the CT-published key ring (TBD — separate RFC for key-ring publication discipline).

signature.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 signature over the JCS-canonical-JSON serialisation of all sibling fields except `signature` itself. Consumer verifies before consuming `entries`.

entries.description: Per-target-repo MCP server source SHA digests. SCP-R-006 Inv-C looks up entries by `target_repo_app_id`.

target_repo_app_id.description: GitHub App installation id of the target repo. Matches `estate_repos.yaml services[].target_repo_app_id`.

mcp_server_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the on-disk `<repo>/.acc/mcp_server.{py,ts}` bytes. 64 hex chars (lowercase). Updated whenever the target repo's MCP server source changes — same-PR manifest update is MANDATORY (RULE-003 §4 FP case 3; Inv-C unconditional-deny).

mcp_server_filename.description: Optional: explicit filename indicator. Useful for adopters whose repo carries both .py and .ts variants in transition.

signed_at.description: Optional: per-entry signed_at, for entries that lag the manifest's top-level signed_at (e.g. cohort-staged adoption).
